verdicts.reason: A: the body copy is squeezed into a narrow, ragged four-line column wedged against the CTA, the legal text is tiny and stacked into six lines in the right corner, and the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is shrunk and tucked into the bottom-left over the circle, so the layout looks cluttered and fragmented. B: it reads cleanly left to right (product, then the one-line headline, copy and legal, then the CTA), but the CTA nearly touches 'last' and sits tight to the right edge, the sale ribbon is a tiny afterthought near the bottom edge, and the bottle is pushed against the left margin.
